v: As Jesus was sitting opposite the treasury, He watched the crowd putting money into it. And many rich people put in large amounts.
Then one poor widow came and put in two small copper coins, which amounted to a small fraction of a denarius.
Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put more than all the others into the treasury.
For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”

paras: One day Jesus was sitting in the main temple, and He was watching the crowd as they gave their offerings. And lots of rich people came by and put in large amounts of money.
Then a poor widow came along and put in two small coins that were hardly worth anything.

Jesus called His closest followers over to Him and said, “Look at this poor widow. I tell you the truth, she has given more than all of those other people. See, they all gave from what they had left over. But she’s poor, and yet she gave all she had to live on.”
